questions.stem: Which combination correctly links the carbon cycle and nitrogen cycle to living organisms?

options.text: Carbon is used for respiration only; nitrogen is used for photosynthesis only
Carbon is needed to build carbohydrates, fats, and proteins; nitrogen is needed to build proteins and DNA
Carbon and nitrogen are only important for plants, not animals
Neither carbon nor nitrogen are recycled in nature

questions.explanation: Carbon is a key element in carbohydrates, fats, and proteins - the major biological molecules. Nitrogen is essential for making amino acids (which form proteins) and nucleic acids (DNA and RNA). Both elements are recycled through their respective biogeochemical cycles.
